Below is a consolidated list of **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
The table shows the *official holiday*, the *date it falls on*, the *observed date* (if the holiday falls on a weekend), and the **three‑day weekend** that results.  

> **Note:**  
> • Federal holidays that create a long weekend are listed for the entire country.  
> • Provincial holidays that create a long weekend are shown for the provinces where they apply.  
> • Some holidays are observed on the nearest weekday if they fall on a weekend.  
> • The list is suitable for integration into a holiday‑planning app; you can copy the JSON block below if you prefer machine‑readable data.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed on | Long‑Weekend Dates | Province(s) (if applicable) |
|---------|-------------|-------------|--------------------|-----------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday, Jan 1 | Monday, Jan 2 | Dec 30 2022 – Jan 2 2023 | All Canada |
| **Family Day** | Monday, Feb 20 | — | Feb 18 – 20 | Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario |
| **Good Friday** | Friday, Apr 7 | — | Apr 7 – 9 | All Canada |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday, May 22 | — | May 20 – 22 | All Canada |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday, Jul 1 | Monday, Jul 3 | Jul 1 – 3 | All Canada |
| **Labour Day** | Monday, Sep 4 | — | Sep 2 – 4 | All Canada |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday, Oct 9 | — | Oct 7 – 9 | All Canada |
| **Remembrance Day** | Saturday, Nov 11 | Friday, Nov 10 | Nov 10 – 12 | All Canada |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday, Dec 25 | — | Dec 23 – 25 | All Canada |
| **Boxing Day** | Tuesday, Dec 26 | — | Dec 26 – 28 | All Canada |
| **Heritage Day** | Monday, Oct 16 | — | Oct 14 – 16 | Ontario |
